nodes.name: 01 · Ingestion Webhook
nodes.notes:
Receives farmer registration payload from triggerN8NWebhook() in src/lib/api.ts.

Expected body:
{
  id: string,           // Supabase UUID
  name: string,
  latitude: number,     // WGS-84 (6 dp)
  longitude: number,
  farm_area_acres: number,
  gat_number: string,   // 7/12 Satbara parcel ID
  taluka: string,
  village: string,
  token_status: 'pending'
}

nodes.name: 02 · Cadastral Bounding Check
nodes.notes:
Validates GPS coordinates fall within Nagpur district bounding box.

Nagpur district extents (approximate WGS-84):
  Latitude:  20.70 – 21.50 N
  Longitude: 78.60 – 79.70 E

True branch  → proceed to Copernicus auth.
False branch → reject with 422 and log the out-of-bounds submission.

nodes.name: 03 · Copernicus CDSE Auth
nodes.notes:
Authenticates with Copernicus Dataspace (CDSE) using the Resource Owner
Password Credentials OIDC flow against the cdse-public client.

Credentials must be stored as n8n Variables:
  COPERNICUS_USER — registered CDSE account email
  COPERNICUS_PASS — CDSE account password

On success: response.access_token is a short-lived JWT bearer token used
in node 04 to query the Sentinel-2 OData product catalogue.

parameters.body:
={
  "id":               "{{ $('01 · Ingestion Webhook').item.json.body.id }}",
  "name":             "{{ $('01 · Ingestion Webhook').item.json.body.name }}",
  "latitude":         {{ $('01 · Ingestion Webhook').item.json.body.latitude }},
  "longitude":        {{ $('01 · Ingestion Webhook').item.json.body.longitude }},
  "farm_area_acres":  {{ $('01 · Ingestion Webhook').item.json.body.farm_area_acres }},
  "gat_number":       "{{ $('01 · Ingestion Webhook').item.json.body.gat_number }}",
  "taluka":           "{{ $('01 · Ingestion Webhook').item.json.body.taluka }}",
  "village":          "{{ $('01 · Ingestion Webhook').item.json.body.village }}"
}

nodes.name: 04 · Python dMRV Engine POST
nodes.notes:
POSTs the farmer record + Copernicus bearer token to the Flask dMRV
microservice (app.py running on Gunicorn).

The engine:
  1. Queries Sentinel-2 OData catalogue for the latest scene
     intersecting POINT(longitude latitude)
  2. Extracts Band 4 (Red) and Band 8 (NIR) reflectance values
  3. Computes NDVI = (B8 - B4) / (B8 + B4)
  4. Computes CO₂ = round(NDVI × (acres × 0.4047) × 10, 2)
  5. PATCHes Supabase farmers table:
       { ndvi_score, co2_tonnes, token_status: 'pending' }

This PATCH triggers the Supabase Realtime CDC event that the Admin
panel (admin.tsx) subscribes to, which then auto-mints the token.

n8n Variable required:
  DMRV_ENGINE_URL — e.g. https://your-flask-server.com/process

Expected response:
  { status: 'success', ndvi: number, co2_tonnes: number }

parameters.responseBody: ={ "status": "rejected", "reason": "GPS coordinates outside Nagpur district bounding box", "latitude": {{ $('01 · Ingestion Webhook').item.json.body.latitude }}, "longitude": {{ $('01 · Ingestion Webhook').item.json.body.longitude }} }

nodes.name: 05 · Reject Out-of-Bounds
nodes.notes:
Returns HTTP 422 to the frontend when the GPS point falls outside
the Nagpur district bounding box. The farmer registration is still
saved in Supabase (insertFarmer fires before the webhook), but
no NDVI processing will occur.

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ status: 'queued', farmer_id: $('01 · Ingestion Webhook').item.json.body.id, message: 'NDVI processing started' }) }}

nodes.name: 06 · Respond 202 Accepted
nodes.notes:
Returns HTTP 202 to the frontend immediately after the dMRV engine
has been called. The actual Supabase write-back is async — the
frontend uses Supabase Realtime to receive the NDVI update.

_meta.description: KisanCredit NDVI orchestration pipeline. Import into n8n via Settings → Import Workflow. Set n8n Variables: COPERNICUS_USER, COPERNICUS_PASS, DMRV_ENGINE_URL before activating.
nodeFlow: 01 · Ingestion Webhook  — receives POST from triggerN8NWebhook() in api.ts
02 · Cadastral Bounding Check — IF node: Nagpur bbox lat 20.7-21.5, lon 78.6-79.7
03 · Copernicus CDSE Auth — OIDC password grant → access_token
04 · Python dMRV Engine POST — Flask /process: Sentinel-2 → NDVI → CO₂ → Supabase PATCH
05 · Reject Out-of-Bounds — 422 response for GPS outside Nagpur district
06 · Respond 202 Accepted — async acknowledgement back to frontend

requiredVariables.DMRV_ENGINE_URL: URL of the Flask dMRV microservice /process endpoint
